elements.requirement: The enactments mentioned in Schedule 4 to the Consumer Protection Act 1987 shall have effect subject to the amendments specified in that Schedule, which are minor amendments and amendments consequential on the provisions of the Act.

elements.requirement: The Trade Descriptions Act 1972 shall cease to have effect.

elements.requirement: The Fabrics (Misdescription) Act 1913 shall cease to have effect.

elements.requirement: The enactments mentioned in Schedule 5 to the Consumer Protection Act 1987 are repealed to the extent specified in the third column of that Schedule.
